name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 6 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2025-08-30, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 5.00 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
